python3 - << 'PY'
import re
p = '/workspace/lib/widgets/hero_feedback_surface.dart'
s = open(p,'r',encoding='utf-8').read()
pattern = re.compile(r"\n\s*// Seek HUD[\s\S]*?\n\s*}\n\s*", re.M)
# We'll replace the first occurrence from the comment line to the end of the segment before the next closing brace of the build method
m = pattern.search(s)
print('Found pattern?', bool(m))
print('Index', m.start() if m else None)
# We'll instead do a targeted replace by specifying the exact text chunk to remove.
old_block = '''            // Seek HUD — time readout + preview line, only while scrubbing.
            if (seeking.value)
              Positioned.fill(
                child: IgnorePointer(
                  child: _SeekHud(
                    fraction: seekDurationMs.value <= 0
                        ? 0
                        : (seekTargetMs.value / seekDurationMs.value)
                            .clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                    label: seekDurationMs.value <= 0
                        ? '--:-- / --:--'
                        : '${formatClock(seekTargetMs.value)} / ${formatClock(seekDurationMs.value)}',
                    palette: palette,
                    typography: typography,
                  ),
                ),
              ),'''
new_block = '''            // Seek HUD moved to bottom-aligned strip; during scrubbing display
            // the target/duration and a progress bar.
            if (seeking.value)
              Positioned(
                left: 0,
                right: 0,
                bottom: 0,
                child: _SeekBottomHud(
                  targetMs: seekTargetMs.value,
                  durationMs: seekDurationMs.value,
                  palette: palette,
                  typography: typography,
                ),
              ),'''
s2 = s.replace(old_block, new_block)
open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s2)
print('Patched? ', s2!=s)
PY

python3 - << 'PY'
import re
p = '/workspace/lib/widgets/hero_feedback_surface.dart'
s = open(p,'r',encoding='utf-8').read()
pattern = re.compile(r"\n\s*// Seek HUD[\s\S]*?\n\s*}\n\s*", re.M)
# We'll replace the first occurrence from the comment line to the end of the segment before the next closing brace of the build method
m = pattern.search(s)
print('Found pattern?', bool(m))
print('Index', m.start() if m else None)
# We'll instead do a targeted replace by specifying the exact text chunk to remove.
old_block = '''            // Seek HUD — time readout + preview line, only while scrubbing.
            if (seeking.value)
              Positioned.fill(
                child: IgnorePointer(
                  child: _SeekHud(
                    fraction: seekDurationMs.value <= 0
                        ? 0
                        : (seekTargetMs.value / seekDurationMs.value)
                            .clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                    label: seekDurationMs.value <= 0
                        ? '--:-- / --:--'
                        : '${formatClock(seekTargetMs.value)} / ${formatClock(seekDurationMs.value)}',
                    palette: palette,
                    typography: typography,
                  ),
                ),
              ),'''
new_block = '''            // Seek HUD moved to bottom-aligned strip; during scrubbing display
            // the target/duration and a progress bar.
            if (seeking.value)
              Positioned(
                left: 0,
                right: 0,
                bottom: 0,
                child: _SeekBottomHud(
                  targetMs: seekTargetMs.value,
                  durationMs: seekDurationMs.value,
                  palette: palette,
                  typography: typography,
                ),
              ),'''
s2 = s.replace(old_block, new_block)
open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s2)
print('Patched? ', s2!=s)
